description: We are a team of enthusiastic CSE students and beginners interested in technology, space, science, and problem-solving. We are looking forward to participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 and building an innovative solution together. We are open to learning new technologies and working as a team. We are looking for motivated members who are interested in coding, UI/UX, research, presentation, data analysis.
summary:
Our project, "Abandoned But Not Forgotten", is an educational website that presents a virtual museum of space objects left behind during space missions. It provides information about old spacecraft, landers, rovers, and scientific instruments that are no longer active on the Moon and Mars.

Our main goal is to show that even after a space mission ends, the objects left behind still have an important story to tell. Through our website, users can explore these objects, learn about their missions, and understand their contribution to space exploration.

We aim to make space history interesting, interactive, and easy to understand for students and space enthusiasts. Our project helps people discover and appreciate the forgotten history of space exploration.
details:
Our project, "Abandoned But Not Forgotten", is a virtual space museum website that helps people explore objects left behind after space missions.

Our website provides information about spacecraft, landers, rovers, and scientific instruments that are no longer active on the Moon and Mars. Users can explore different space missions and learn about the history and importance of these objects.

We developed this website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We used VS Code for coding and GitHub for storing and managing our project files.

The main benefit of our project is to make space exploration history easy and interesting for students and space lovers. It helps people understand that even after a mission ends, the objects left behind are still an important part of space history.

Our creative idea is to present this information through a simple and interactive virtual museum. In the future, we plan to add more missions, 3D models, animations, and interactive features.
